evals.name: account-plan-generator-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Maya is the Head of Operations who is driving a January pilot in three stores. Theo is the owner who signs above 20 thousand and has not joined a call. Priyank is the Finance Lead who said the budget is not set. Gaps: budget not set, Theo not on a call, POS export dependency. The rep claim that the pilot will pay for itself is not used as a fact. No expansion section is invented.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
Theo is listed as the signer who has not joined a call
The three gaps (budget, Theo, POS export) are listed with quotes
The rep claim that the pilot will pay for itself is not written as a fact
No expansion idea appears that the account did not raise

evals.name: account-plan-generator-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run account-plan-generator on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
